messages.author: 8fd6da1e9e93c4dd
messages.subject: using Generated Quantities to find probabilities: not working..Why?
parts:
The wrote the following stan code for mortality rates in 12 hospital (Vol I WinBugs) exmple..It is working and giving the correct values for beta0. I try to calculate the corresponding probabilities  in generated quantities but I am not getting the correct values ...I don't understand this...hand calculation using bata0 values gives the correct values for the probabilities...can someone help me with this!!!!

data {

int<lower=0> y[12]; // number of successes

int<lower=0> n[12]; // number of trials

}

parameters {

 vector[12] beta0;

real<lower=0>mu_beta0;

real<lower=0>tau;

}

transformed parameters{

    real<lower=0> sigma_u0;

    sigma_u0<-1.0/sqrt(tau);

}

model{

mu_beta0~normal(0, 100); 

beta0~normal(mu_beta0, sigma_u0);

tau~gamma(1.0E-3, 1.0E-3);

   beta0~normal(mu_beta0, sigma_u0);

   y~binomial_logit(n,beta0); 

}

generated quantities{

  real  p[12]; // probability

 for (j in 1:12)

p[j]<-exp(beta0[j])/(1+exp(beta0[j]));

}
